description: 家用桶裝瓦斯價格 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 國內各縣市家用液化石油氣(桶裝瓦斯)(20KG)價格並於本署網頁更新，以提供民眾瞭解液化石油氣價格動態資訊。 民眾可瞭解不同區域(含外離島)家用桶裝液化石油氣價格差異；因價格資訊公開，及民眾消費力量，銷售價格將趨於合理化。 提供家用桶裝液化石油氣參考零售價格資訊查詢，讓消費者及瓦斯行作參考。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
